callouts.id: 利用Stolz定理确定递归序列的渐近系数#1
callouts.title: 问题1
callouts.body: 数列$\{x_n\}_{n\geq 1}$的初值为$1$,并且满足递推关系$$x_{n+1}=x_{n}+3\sqrt{x_n}+\frac{n}{\sqrt{x_n}}$$求$$\lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{x_n}{n^2}$$

classification_result.id: 利用Stolz定理确定递归序列的渐近系数#1

if_problem.statement_en: The sequence $\{x_n\}_{n\geq 1}$ has initial value $x_1=1$ and satisfies the recurrence relation $$x_{n+1}=x_{n}+3\sqrt{x_n}+\frac{n}{\sqrt{x_n}}.$$ Find $$\lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{x_n}{n^2}.$$

callouts.id: 利用Stolz定理确定递归序列的渐近系数#2
callouts.title: 为什么猜答案是很有用的?
callouts.body: 如果把解决问题比喻为在无穷的空间当中搜索一条正确的路径，那么猜出合理的结果以后，我们搜索的范围就极大地缩小了。

classification_result.id: 利用Stolz定理确定递归序列的渐近系数#2
classification_result.english_title: Why Is Guessing the Answer Useful?

callouts.id: 利用Stolz定理确定递归序列的渐近系数#3
callouts.title: 主要想法
callouts.body: 既然我们猜到了结果，那么反过来验证结果的合理性就行了。毕竟这个序列的前500万的数据告诉我们，$\frac{x_n}{n^2}$是单调增加到$\frac{9}{4}$去的，那么为什么我们不直接使用归纳法去验证，$$x_n\leq \frac{9}{4}n^2$$

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Guess the Limit and Verify by Induction
if_strategy_template.summary_en: After conjecturing the asymptotic limit from data or heuristic reasoning, reduce the problem to proving a sharp inequality consistent with that guess. Then use induction to verify the bound and support the proposed asymptotic behavior.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when a recursive sequence suggests a plausible asymptotic constant and the recurrence allows inductive upper or lower bounds that match the conjectured growth rate.

callouts.id: 利用Stolz定理确定递归序列的渐近系数#4
callouts.title: 主要想法
callouts.body: 我们主要的想法是利用[[Cesaro-Stolz定理#1.2 分母单调无界的一般情况]]提到的广义的定理提供的关于序列上下极限，以及差分版本的序列的上下极限，并结合递归关系得到的不等式，从而得到关于$a,b$的不等式。

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Use the Generalized Cesaro-Stolz Theorem with Recurrence Inequalities
if_strategy_template.summary_en: Apply the generalized Cesaro-Stolz theorem to relate the upper and lower limits of a sequence to those of its difference sequence. Then combine these relations with inequalities derived from the recurrence to obtain constraints on the asymptotic coefficients.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies to recursively defined sequences when one wants asymptotic growth coefficients and can derive useful inequalities for successive differences.
